stem: A window grille in Agra, India, is made of straight metal bars. In the part shown, bars \(\ell\) and \(m\) are parallel, and a third straight bar crosses both. What is the measure, in degrees, of the larger of the two labeled angles?
solution: The two labeled angles lie between the parallel bars on the same side of the crossing bar, so they are same-side interior angles and add up to \(180^{\circ}\).
The angles are \(7(17) - 5 = 114\) and \(3(17) + 15 = 66\) degrees; the larger is \(114^{\circ}\).

explanation.B: Incorrect. This is the value of \(x\), not an angle measure.
explanation.C: Incorrect. This sets the two angles equal, \(7x - 5 = 3x + 15\), which gives \(x = 5\) and angles of \(30^{\circ}\). Same-side interior angles are supplementary, not equal.
explanation.D: Incorrect. This is the smaller of the two angles, \(3(17) + 15\).

verify:
choices = {o: choices[n] for o, n in {'D': 'A', 'A': 'B', 'B': 'C', 'C': 'D'}.items()}; answer = {'A': 'D', 'B': 'A', 'C': 'B', 'D': 'C'}[answer]  # shuffled: original letters
P=figure['points']
d=lambda a,b: sqrt((P[a][0]-P[b][0])**2+(P[a][1]-P[b][1])**2)
ang=lambda a,v,b: N(acos(((P[a][0]-P[v][0])*(P[b][0]-P[v][0])+(P[a][1]-P[v][1])*(P[b][1]-P[v][1]))/(d(a,v)*d(b,v)))*180/pi)
x=symbols('x')
xs=solve(Eq((7*x-5)+(3*x+15),180),x)[0]
assert abs(ang('K','F','E')-(7*xs-5))<0.1 and abs(ang('V','E','F')-(3*xs+15))<0.1
ans=max(7*xs-5,3*xs+15)
assert value(choices[answer])==ans==114
assert all(value(choices[k])!=ans for k in choices if k!=answer)
